p01.label: jungles west of Drankor
p01.note: Identified as the Awakened Jungle from Pip, Canopy and its talking inhabitants.

evidence.quote: DM: Okay. So, we begin tonight in the jungles west of Drankor near the—

DM: Well, you can't, really. I guess it depends on whether you've climbed down from Vindristjarna yet or not, because from the skyship you can't see the the jungle floor. The canopy is thick, so, assuming you've landed at this point and are sort of creeping forward on the ground, you can see the tangled nest of crawling vines and thorns that marks the chaotic corruption that seems to have silenced this tree, known as the Eldest, or Canopy, and put a pall on the jungle. Pip, the fruit bat who guided you towards where she found the jade was full of stories as she flew, telling you about well, what she learned as a child only a few years ago, as she learned to talk as she learned to fly, not really knowing anything about the history of the jungle, and not really thinking it strange that she could speak elvish. But you heard tales from her of the mango trees that sing ballads when their fruit is ripe, calling her and her people and her companions to come feast; of the trickster monkeys who live on the mangroves on the coast, protected by Slither, an ancient boa constrictor, who run around the jungle howling news and gossip to everybody, but have been quiet of late; the orchids that bloom and whisper love poems to hummingbirds; the groves of banyan trees that speak in many voices, turning the stories of the jungle into dramatic plays. The Fire Clan, led by the Tiger Blaze, who live along the Big River to the west, keeping a watchful eye.
